row: Morris Animal Foundation is one of the largest global nonprofits funding studies to advance the health of dogs, cats, horses and wildlife. With the help of passionate donors, each year we fund between 120 to 150 new studies that seek to solve the most critical health problems in animals. From saving endangered species to developing new treatments for cancer and detecting emerging health crises, together we give animals their best lives.
